outputs.name_help: Select a name of your new output that describes it.
outputs.plugin_error: The plugin required for this output is not loaded. Editing it is not possible. Please load the plugin or delete the output.

stream_outputs.description: {{productName}} nodes can forward messages of streams via outputs. Launch or terminate as many outputs as you want here. You can also reuse outputs that are already running for other streams. A global view of all configured outputs is available <outputsLink>here</outputsLink>.
stream_outputs.marketplace_prefix: You can find output plugins on
stream_outputs.removing_description: <emphasis>Removing</emphasis> an output removes it from this stream but it will still be in the list of available outputs. Deleting an output <emphasis>globally</emphasis> will remove it from this and all other streams and terminate it. You can see all defined outputs in details at the <outputsLink>global output list</outputsLink>.
stream_outputs.title: Outputs for Stream »{{streamTitle}}«

system_outputs.description: {{productName}} nodes can forward messages via outputs. Launch or terminate as many outputs as you want here <highlight>and then assign them to streams to forward all messages of a stream in real-time.</highlight>
system_outputs.marketplace_prefix: You can find output plugins in
system_outputs.title: Outputs

streams_page.title: Streams
streams_page.description: You can route incoming messages into streams by applying rules against them. Messages matching the rules of a stream are routed into it. A message can also be routed into multiple streams.

stream_edit_page.title: Rules of Stream {{title}}
stream_edit_page.description: This screen is dedicated to an easy and comfortable creation and manipulation of stream rules. You can see the effect configured stream rules have on message matching here.
stream_edit_page.default_stream_error: The default stream cannot be edited.

stream_permission_error_page.title: Missing Stream Permissions
stream_permission_error_page.description_p1: This resource includes streams you do not have permissions for.
stream_permission_error_page.description_p2: Please contact your administrator and provide the error details which include a list of streams you need access to.
stream_permission_error_page.error_details: You need permissions for streams with the id: {{ids}}.

user_no_stream_access.title: No stream permissions.
user_no_stream_access.alert: We cannot start a search right now, because you are not allowed to access any stream. If you feel this is an error, please contact your administrator.
